WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the check function's parsed syntax tree. It changes when the check's logic changes and not when its comments or formatting do. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: Report #79 documents the original failure: the recipe says to clone the best 30-day performer and the leaderboard rows carry six different headline_period values. Deep pass 2026-09-08, 3/3: 'does the period narrow it' was a COUNT comparison, so eight of sixteen rows still spanning four periods read as narrowed and passed on the violation, and a non-200 on the narrowed request emitted the accusation about a request that errored. It compares periods now, and a failed read is inconclusive.
